note: Plan 0031, D5 (step 2): the packs of the web build that the game gets while it runs. The main pack (index.pck) is the start pack: the code, the screens, the ground and the roads, and what shows near the start points. Each pack here has its files (resources of the project: tools/web/make_pack.gd puts each with its import), and its area (x0, z0, x1, z1 of the game) with the distance near_m around it: the game gets the pack when the player comes nearer (scripts/web/web_packs.gd), and the things of the pack show when it is there. tools/web/prepare.py leaves these files out of the main pack. The desktop builds keep one whole pack.

packs.note: The people of World (the walkers, the sitters, and the swimmers of the showcase, and the aerobics group of the morning exercise): their mid and far levels, about 93 MB. Their area is the showcase of Bãi Trước (data/showcase/bai_truoc.json, outline).
